title: The GiveWP – Donation Plugin and Fundraising Platform plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to donor account account…
description: The GiveWP Donation Plugin for WordPress up to version 4.17.0 contains a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset the password of any WordPress account linked to a donor record. This occurs because the plugin does not properly validate donor identity before updating linked WordPress account passwords. Exploiting this flaw can lead to full site compromise and remote code execution if the targeted account has administrator privileges. The attack requires a published GiveWP form with a usable gateway, enabled donor email access (default setting), knowledge of the donor's email address, and an existing linked account. This vulnerability can be combined with CVE-2026-82676 to facilitate administrator account takeover.
